resolved_findings.verification: EN/ZH normative fuel_blend_ownership and both gasoline/diesel cards explicitly choose one whole-blend supply with composition/carbon-origin bookkeeping OR physical components replacing corresponding whole-blend quantity/upstream burdens with mass/native-unit/provider closure. resolved_findings.english_rule: | fuel_blend_ownership | gasoline_supply; diesel_supply | Declare whether actual supplied fuel is represented as one verified compatible whole-blend supply or as physical component supplies. Component exchanges replace the matching whole-blend quantity and covered upstream burdens, with mass, native units and provider-scope closure. Never add the full supplied blend plus its contained bio/fossil component supply; neither route may omit an actual constituent or its upstream burden. | ipcc-mobile-combustion; ghg-product-standard |
